# ISSUE-285 implementation plan

Refresh the accepted tester-only retry design for the operator-designated approved base `108cc164`, including merged activity tracking. Add `swarm issue work <issue> --phase test` and `swarm pr work <PR> --phase test` on direct GitHub and local backends. An eligible retry runs one tester and all trusted required checks, with zero developer calls, including when checks fail. This is planning only; implementation follows fresh content-bound independent review.

Dimensions are approved: multi_area / known / sensitive. The scoped implementation and verification should fit the 16-hour claim budget.

## What we know

- Work phase validation currently accepts all/plan/review/implement (`internal/contract/security.go:59`); persisted lease and handoff APIs use that same validator (`internal/lease/manager.go:810,1260,1312`). Adding test to that validator would accidentally widen coordination APIs.
- `developerRound` checkpoints first, computes PASS/FAIL, then records implementation through ordinary UpdateArtifact (`internal/workflow/execute_implementation.go:16`). Ordinary recording does not establish trusted completion. `UpdateArtifact` and `RecordTrustedValidation` already distinguish generic input from coordinator evidence and strip reserved validation provenance (`internal/lease/manager.go:1551-1596`).
- Current resume reuse requires the claim-budget reason and compares ReviewBindings except review_claim_id (`internal/workflow/claim_budget.go:167`). It is not sufficient evidence for this new explicit retry.
- `ExecuteWork` establishes progress/activity context, claims, heartbeat and workspace before dispatching plan, review and implementation (`internal/workflow/engine.go:500-568`). `validationRound` already enforces tester imports and runs trusted validation; `validateAndRepair` can invoke developers after check failures (`internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:16`). Explicit test must bypass that repair loop.
- PR work preflights before withClaim, prepares the managed PR worktree and calls BeginPRRevision (`internal/pr/service.go:664`). Preserve existing revision evidence on retries rather than starting a fresh revision or resetting its checkpoint.
- Manual stage records implementation PASS (`internal/cli/stage.go:272`); reconciliation also constructs PASS (`internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile.go:191`). Neither is successful developer execution provenance.
- RootOptions already has progressReporter, progressSession, trackerOverride, lookupEnv and resolverRunner seams (`internal/cli/root.go:31-64`). Workflow activity wiring exists at `internal/workflow/engine.go:502-521`, and claim setup/heartbeat at `internal/workflow/execute_setup.go:56,130`. Reuse these; do not replace RootOptions or heartbeat code.
- Human recovery text currently directs refused tester output through implementation (`internal/workflow/import_policy.go:174`; `docs/developer.md:24`). Structured recovery is centralized in `internal/cli/next_action.go:94`.

## What we're assuming

The supplied source snapshot is the approved `108cc164` identified by the operator. This sandbox has no Git metadata, so `git rev-parse HEAD` cannot independently establish the SHA. Inspecting the supplied source confirms the merged activity seams. No prior PLAN/TEST_PLAN or accepted review text is present; F1-F4 below preserve the operator's accepted requirements without inventing additional review findings. No external service or approval lookup is a prerequisite for implementation.

## Open questions

No blocking design questions. During implementation, settle small helper placement and exact reserved metadata names against adjacent lease conventions. The test matrix below answers claim rollover, PR revision retention and rejection races locally. Live GitHub execution is optional maintainer review evidence, not an implementation gate.

## Design and implementation sequence

### 1. Separate command phase from persisted phase (F4)

Modify `internal/contract/security.go` and its existing tests to add a separate `ValidateWorkPhase` accepting existing work phases plus test. Keep `ValidatePhase` unchanged for claim/update/handoff/stage/fork APIs. Work CLI and engine preflight use the work validator. Normalize test to implement before any Acquire/AcquirePR, persisted phase, admission, pause/handoff or gateway boundary; retain the requested command phase in WorkOptions for dispatch and results. LeadRole(test) and rolesForPhase(test) select tester only. No developer/planner/reviewer runner or dependency preflight is needed for this phase, though approved gate verification remains mandatory.

Change `internal/cli/work.go:37,206`, `internal/cli/pr.go:85,284`, `internal/workflow/engine.go:63,135,313,472`, `internal/workflow/execute_setup.go:56`, and `internal/pr/service.go:664` at their existing work-option/claim boundaries. PR service claim acquisition must see the normalized phase as well. Reject unsupported fork/gateway test work in issue/PR command/service and engine preflight before claims, remote requests or revision mutation; use HasWorkerGateway in addition to fork options. Do not add fork operations or enable test for stage, claim, update-phase or handoff.

### 2. Manager-owned completion evidence (F1/F2)

Modify `internal/lease/manager.go:1551` with a narrow coordinator-only `RecordTrustedImplementation` path and a reusable eligibility verifier. Keep artifact schema unchanged by using reserved `implementation_trusted_*` metadata. Generic artifact ingestion strips this entire namespace before gateway dispatch and local mutation, just as validation provenance is stripped; only the trusted manager path stamps it, inside a fenced mutation, and refuses gateway use. Do not stamp provenance in workflow-provided metadata.

Record only successful developer completion after accepted imports, successful checkpoint recording and PASS determination in `developerRound`. Stamp authenticated producing owner and producing claim, checkpoint head and Git tree, issue/PR revision identity, approved base, task and policy digests, and approved plan/test-plan digests from authoritative state. Reject missing/FAIL outcomes and mismatched checkpoint/bindings. Failed/interrupted developer execution never gets completion evidence. Ordinary stage/reconciler PASS and forged metadata remain ineligible.

Keep the producing-claim identity immutable. A later retry may acquire a different claim: check trusted completion against its recorded producing claim and recorded approval bindings, compare all stable bindings to the current approved state, and independently fence every retry read/mutation against the retry run's current claim, owner, expiry and policy. Do not require producing claim == retry claim or compare its review_claim_id against a new claim. A legitimate new claim must not rewrite provenance to look newly produced. Stale retry claims must still return errors wrapping ErrClaimFence.

### 3. Explicit tester-only execution (F3)

Modify `internal/workflow/engine.go:500`, `execute_setup.go`, `execute_implementation.go`, `execute_validation.go`, `execute_run.go`, and `claim_budget.go` in place. Dispatch explicit test through shared setup and a small retry preparation helper before plan/review/developer execution. Recheck eligibility after claim/workspace setup and immediately before tester launch. Require recorded successful trusted implementation, exact head and tree, clean candidate (tracked, staged and untracked changes using existing workspace exclusions), no rebase, matching issue/PR branch and revision, current task/base/policy/plan/test-plan and satisfied exact-content gate. Missing evidence fails closed with implementation recovery guidance; never fall back to developerRound.

For PRs require the existing pending revision's local implementation checkpoint, preserve it through BeginPRRevision/setup, and use that head rather than the published PR head. Reject a fresh/unimplemented revision, mismatched PR identity or moved checkpoint. Revalidate current state and claim at import and trusted validation recording; reuse CAS fencing rather than carrying a preflight snapshot as authority.

Run validationRound exactly once and then finish with PhaseCompleted=test on success. Do not call validateAndRepair for explicit test; required-check failure remains failed even with a nonzero configured repair budget. Keep all existing tester writable-path/import restrictions, refused-output handling, required-check policy from BaseSHA, trusted validation stamping and existing diagnostics. Retry writes only tester-owned role artifacts; coordinator validation/projection/provenance remain coordinator-owned. Never modify or replace implementation evidence on retry, including rejection/interruption/failure. Reject moved candidate before passing validation can be persisted.

Preserve existing all/implement behavior, including its claim-budget reuse and repair semantics; the new explicit retry uses the stronger eligibility check without broadening automatic reuse. Preserve existing activity context, setup reporter, check callbacks, cancellation, heartbeat lifecycle, renewal masking and budget pause behavior. Persist implement on pauses while recovery guidance may name --phase test when eligible.

### 4. Recovery, help and release note

Modify `internal/workflow/import_policy.go:174`, `internal/cli/next_action.go:94` and their tests so eligible tester refusal/interruption recommends the real issue/PR --phase test command. Eligibility must come from coordinator evidence, never error text alone; preserve developer refusal recovery and ineligible implementation guidance. Structured argv keeps backend, repo/root and remote selections through existing builders. Unsupported fork mode must not advertise an executable tester retry.

Update `docs/developer.md` recovery paragraph, role-instruction example and structured next-action guidance with the eligibility conditions, normal implementation fallback and examples for both commands on GitHub and local backends. Explicitly explain that test reruns tester plus all required checks and never repairs source automatically. CLI help names test only for work. Add `changes/unreleased/285.md` with the user-visible recovery feature. Do not edit protected command templates, harness files or workflow schemas.

## Verification and independent review

TEST_PLAN.md supplies self-contained acceptance coverage and commands. Independent reviewer should inspect reserved metadata stripping/stamping, producing versus retry claim separation, gate/content binding, PR setup retention, pre-claim fork/gateway refusal and absence of a developer path on test failure. Run focused tests followed by required checks and make check during implementation, not this plan-only phase. No new behavior or blocking external prerequisites are introduced.

## HANDOFF

- Entry points: `internal/contract/security.go:59` ValidatePhase (preserve; add adjacent work validator); `internal/cli/work.go:18` newWorkCmd; `internal/cli/pr.go:49` newPRActionCmd; `internal/cli/root.go:31` RootOptions (reuse existing seams); `internal/pr/service.go:664` Work; `internal/workflow/engine.go:135,313,472,500` LeadRole/preflight/rolesForPhase/ExecuteWork; `internal/workflow/execute_setup.go:56,130` claimRun/startHeartbeat; `internal/workflow/execute_implementation.go:16` developerRound; `internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:16` validationRound; `internal/workflow/claim_budget.go:167` implementationProven (preserve automatic semantics); `internal/lease/manager.go:1551,1563` UpdateArtifact/updateArtifact; `internal/workflow/import_policy.go:174` importRejectionReason; `internal/cli/next_action.go:94` classify.
- Extend existing fixtures/tests: workflow `work_validation_test.go`, `import_policy_test.go` (TestImportRejectionRecovery, TestTesterReadsApprovedInputs), `claim_budget_test.go`, `activity_engine_test.go`; lease `manager_test.go`, `validation_reuse_test.go`, `checkpoint_reconcile_test.go`; PR `service_test.go`, `work_validation_test.go`, `submit_unimplemented_test.go`; CLI `next_action_test.go`, `work_validation_test.go`, `work_progress_test.go`, `activity_redaction_test.go`; contract `security_test.go`. All are modified existing files if touched. Production touchpoints above already exist. The sole proposed new file `changes/unreleased/285.md` is absent in the supplied approved snapshot (checked by directory listing); there is no Git object store to query separately.
- Exact focused commands: `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/pr ./internal/cli`; `go test -race ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/pr ./internal/cli ./internal/progress`. Full commands are in TEST_PLAN.md.
- Checked assumptions: read active contract/system instructions and repository project/architecture/conventions; inspected slash-command instructions, current dispatch, phase validation, provenance pattern, PR flow, root options and activity tests. `rg` is unavailable; searches used grep/find. No prior artifacts or Git metadata are available.
- Reopen the plan if implementation requires changing approval semantics, accepting stage/reconciler completions, new fork operations, protected files, broad automatic-resume behavior or replacing heartbeat/activity machinery. Keep unrelated improvements out of this WorkUnit.
- **What this change breaks**: searches found work-only phase allowlists/help in work.go/pr.go/engine.go (update), shared persisted ValidatePhase callers in manager.go and stage (preserve unchanged), refusal text and assertions in import_policy.go/import_policy_test.go (update only eligible tester cases), structured recovery assertions in next_action_test.go/work_validation_test.go (extend), docs/developer.md:24,480,552 (update relevant recovery examples/table). Stage PASS at stage.go:272, reconciliation PASS at checkpoint_reconcile.go:191 and PR submission checks at service.go:1340 remain valid for their existing uses but do not confer retry eligibility. Existing claim-budget/repair tests and activity/heartbeat/progress/redaction tests must remain passing; extend fixtures requiring new explicit retry evidence through the trusted manager path, never by weakening negative tests. Protected harness command templates and docs for ordinary implementation recovery remain unchanged.

# ISSUE-285 test plan

This mapping is complete without previous plan artifacts. Tests are planned additions/extensions, not tests already run. Use existing Git fixture helpers, fake agent runners, local tracker/CAS stores, PR fixtures, injected clocks and current RootOptions/progress seams. No live GitHub, paid agent, container runtime or external prerequisite is required.

## Acceptance 1: explicit issue/PR test retry, zero developers, trusted checks

Extend `internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go` and `import_policy_test.go`, and `internal/pr/work_validation_test.go`/`service_test.go`:

1. Create an approved task, stage/review a bound plan using existing fixtures, and execute a real fake developer success through the workflow. Make the first tester return forbidden output (including IMPLEMENTATION.md/approved-input writes), exercising the actual import rejection path. Assert returned edits are absent and no passing validation artifact exists; preserve trusted developer completion and candidate head/tree.
2. Invoke issue --phase test on the same candidate. Reset invocation counters immediately before retry; assert developer=0, tester=1 and a required-check sentinel executes. Assert trusted validation PASS bound to current claim/head/policy; implementation evidence and source remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
3. Repeat for the PR command/service using an existing pending revision where local implementation head differs from published PR head. Assert revision/checkpoint retained, no new revision reset or publication, same counters and check sentinel.
4. Repeat interrupted/failed tester recovery, current-claim resume and legitimate release/reacquisition under a new retry claim. Producing completion retains its original producing owner/claim; the new retry claim fences trusted validation. Approved stable bindings still match.
5. Configure a positive automatic repair budget, make required checks fail, and assert developer=0/tester=1, sentinel execution, failed trusted report, no repair round and no PASS. A tester runner error or refused output itself cannot produce PASS; rerunning refused output remains failed and never imports prohibited edits.

Commands: `go test ./internal/workflow ./internal/pr`; race coverage below.

## Acceptance 2: adversarial eligibility, real guidance/help, make check

Extend `internal/lease/manager_test.go`/`validation_reuse_test.go`, workflow tests above and PR `service_test.go`/`submit_unimplemented_test.go`. Use a table which changes one condition per valid fixture:

| Case | Required assertion |
| --- | --- |
| No implementation; FAIL; blocked/no-change developer; developer error/interruption before completion | Retry rejects before tester/checks; no developer fallback or passing artifact |
| Generic artifact with forged implementation_trusted_* keys; spoofed producer; manual stage PASS; reconciler PASS; legacy unstamped PASS | Generic input strips reserved keys before gateway and local mutation; none is retry eligible |
| Trusted recorder called with wrong type/FAIL/head/tree/bindings or gateway manager | Reject; no trusted completion persisted and no gateway operation emitted |
| Modified tracked, staged or untracked candidate; head changed with same tree; tree changed; rebase; branch mismatch | Reject exact candidate mismatch; tester=0, developer=0; preserve candidate edits |
| Task, base, policy, design or test-plan digest changes independently | Reject each stale binding; policy/checks still load from approved base |
| Missing/rejected/stale gate; agent verdict for human gate | Reject without reviewer/developer fallback; normal gate policy preserved |
| Current retry token missing/stale/expired, owner mismatch, CAS successor between preflight/launch/import/record | Refuse writes; errors preserve ErrClaimFence through wrapping; no successor overwritten or stale PASS |
| New legitimate retry claim with unchanged trusted producing completion | Accept without comparing producing claim to retry claim; completion provenance unchanged |
| PR absent/fresh pending revision, wrong PR identity/branch/local head, changed revision or moved remote context | Reject; no checkpoint reset, implicit publish or developer execution |
| Candidate/state moves during tester/checks | Cannot persist passing evidence for the moved candidate |

Record calls and state before/after negative cases. Use synchronization hooks/CAS test stores to make races deterministic, not sleeps. Reserved metadata stamping tests must show fields derive from manager state rather than caller metadata. Extend checkpoint reconciliation tests only to establish retry ineligibility; preserve reconciliation's existing behavior.

Extend `internal/contract/security_test.go`: ValidateWorkPhase accepts test; ValidatePhase still rejects test. Existing all/plan/review/implement validation remains unchanged. Capture manager calls/state to prove work test normalizes to implement before acquisition, phase update, admission and pause/handoff; work results/help may report test. Stage/claim/handoff must not gain a test phase.

Extend CLI `next_action_test.go`, `work_validation_test.go`, PR/work fixtures and existing root options:

- Both work --help outputs list test; valid command parsing reaches tester-only execution, not just validation of the flag. Test direct local and fake-GitHub tracker paths using existing injection seams.
- JSON next_action argv and readable refusal/interruption guidance name issue/PR work --phase test only when eligible. Preserve backend, repo/root and upstream selection and tester instructions. Developer failures and absent completion keep implementation recovery. Required-check failures stay failed with repair guidance as appropriate.
- Fork option and gateway-only engine/service configurations refuse test before acquire/acquire-pr, Resume, BeginPRRevision, outbound fork dispatch, or agent execution; dry-run reports unsupported eligibility without mutation. No new fork operations. Existing fork operation synchronization tests remain passing.
- Existing unrelated CLI errors/exit behavior and selection flags remain unchanged.

Commands: `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/pr ./internal/cli`.

## Activity and behavior regression coverage

Run existing workflow activity_engine_test.go/activity_test.go/progress_test.go/claim_budget_test.go, lease activity_test.go/heartbeat_stop_test.go, CLI work_progress_test.go/activity_redaction_test.go and progress package tests. Add one tester-only progress assertion using existing injected reporter/session/tick seams: setup precedes tester and required-check events, no developer event, one finish, cancellation stops heartbeat, and renewal I/O remains excluded from foreground activity. Preserve existing all/implement repair and budget reuse tests; no root-options redeclaration or heartbeat implementation replacement.

Command: `go test -race ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/pr ./internal/cli ./internal/progress`.

## Documentation, release note and required verification

Review `docs/developer.md` with concrete examples for `swarm issue work 42 --phase test --backend github`, `swarm issue work 42 --phase test --backend local`, `swarm pr work 123 --phase test --backend github` and `swarm pr work 123 --phase test --backend local`. Explain unchanged trusted completion, tester-only ownership, required checks, no automatic source repair, and implementation fallback when ineligible. Verify commands against updated Cobra registration and command help using `go run ./cmd/swarm issue work --help` and `go run ./cmd/swarm pr work --help`. Parse changed bash snippets with `bash -n` via a scratch file; resolve any changed relative links. Validate `changes/unreleased/285.md` using the existing changelog checker.

After implementation run the approved checks directly:

```bash
unformatted=$(gofmt -s -l .); if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi
go build ./...
go vet ./...
go tool staticcheck ./...
go test ./...
make check
```

`make check` adds race tests and changelog validation. Independent content-bound plan review precedes implementation; subsequent review checks F1 producing/retry claim separation, F2 manager-only provenance, F3 stage/reconciler exclusion and pre-claim gateway refusal, F4 separate work validator and persisted normalization. A live GitHub smoke run may be recorded by maintainers but does not block sandbox implementation or replace deterministic coverage.

# ISSUE-285 plan review (refresh against 108cc164 with activity tracking)

PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md are the same text as the prior design and test-plan artifacts in WORKUNIT.md and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. F1–F4 are preserved. The source citations in "What we know" check out against the supplied snapshot. One claim-boundary seam is missing and needs a small revision before implementation.

## Audit

| Item | Status | Evidence / note |
| --- | --- | --- |

Acquire uses `r.opts.Phase` at `internal/workflow/execute_setup.go:67`. The plan normalizes before Acquire/AcquirePR and leaves `ValidatePhase` unchanged. |
| F1 producing claim vs retry fence | OK | Producing claim/owner stays immutable. The retry claim is fenced separately with ErrClaimFence wrapping, and TEST_PLAN has a "new legitimate retry claim" row. |
| F2 manager-only provenance, strip/stamp | OK | Mirrors `validation_trusted_*` stripping before gateway/mutation (`internal/lease/manager.go:1563-1580`). The plan adds `implementation_trusted_*`, stamps only inside a fenced mutation, and refuses the gateway. Tests cover forged keys and assert fields derive from state. |

Refusal is required before Acquire/AcquirePR/BeginPRRevision. |

## Required revision

**F5: `issue work --next --phase test` is unspecified and can turn into a developer run.** The plan moves `newWorkCmd` PreRunE (`internal/cli/work.go:37`) to `ValidateWorkPhase` and says to "normalize test to implement before any Acquire". It never mentions the `--next` path:

- `pullNextReadyIssue` validates and uses `opts.Phase` (`internal/cli/selection.go:58,122-156`). It runs `PreflightForClaim` and claims a *fresh* ready issue.
- `newWorkCmd` then overwrites the requested phase with `opts.Phase = pulled.TargetPhase` (`internal/cli/work.go:91`).

If an implementer adds the normalization in the selection path, `--next --phase test` would claim an unrelated issue under `implement`. It would then run `developerRound` and `validateAndRepair`, violating developer=0 and "never fall back to developerRound". If they don't, the result depends on whether `selection.go:58` stays on `ValidatePhase`. Either way the behavior is unplanned and untested.

Required:
1. PLAN §1: state that `--phase test` requires an explicit issue/PR number. Reject `--next` (and so `--all`) with `--phase test` in `newWorkCmd` PreRunE, before `pullNextReadyIssue`, any preflight or any claim. Keep `pullNextReadyIssue` on `ValidatePhase` as defence in depth. `swarm node` and `swarm claim` hard-code `all` (`internal/cli/node.go:168`, `internal/cli/claim.go:47`) and stay unchanged.
2. TEST_PLAN A2 (CLI bullet): add a case where `issue work --next --phase test` (and `--next --all --phase test`) fails before any tracker or lease call. Record zero Acquire/state mutation and zero agent runs. Also assert that `pullNextReadyIssue` still rejects `test` if it is reached directly.

## Advisory (non-blocking)

- Add `internal/cli/selection.go:58` and `internal/lease/manager.go:977` to the "What this change breaks" list of preserved `ValidatePhase` callers.
- The `WorkOptions.Phase` comment (`internal/workflow/engine.go:63`) should list `test` as a command-only value.
- `rolesForPhase`/`LeadRole` default to planner for unknown phases (`engine.go:136-145,472-497`). Add `test` explicitly. Don't rely on `default`.

Once F5 is added, this can be approved without reopening F1–F4.
